episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Ambitious Bristol-based lawyer Claudia travels to Jamaica to challenge an inheritance claim made by local man Cudjoe East against wealthy white aristocrat Oliver Connaught. The case takes an unsettling turn when Claudia discovers that the disputed estate is the very place that has haunted her nightmares - the Connaught family's former plantation.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As Claudia and Oliver search for Cudjoe, unsettling events at Hope Hill force them to confront the estate's disturbing past.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Claudia is rescued by Cudjoe after Oliver becomes unexpectedly violent at Hope Hill, but she struggles to believe him when he explains his sister Charlotte has possessed Oliver.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Claudia seeks out her Aunt Mercy to help her defeat Charlotte and is put in a trance-like state led by their ancestors, transporting her back to 1991, days after her birth.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Trapped at Hope Hill, Claudia must embrace her British and Jamaican heritage to defeat Charlotte's spirit and face the truth about Hope Hill.
